participation.context: Wrote the line and did not begin the letter.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the one line in the almanac and set the groats and the comfits out. The paper for home was still blank.

title: Marked the twins' day and set the groats out

participation.context: Wrote the letter and sealed the groats into the paper.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote to Anne, Hamnet, Judith, and Susanna on one leaf, put in two groats and a twist of comfits, and dated it from London this Candlemas day. You did not send it.

title: Wrote the Candlemas letter and put the groats in

participation.context: Stopped, and did not add a speech about the children.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said the paper was still in the room, and that Thursday was soon enough.

title: Left the packet on the desk
